perms.name: VIEW_CHANNEL
perms.label: View Channels
perms.note: Allows members to view channels by default (excluding private channels).

perms.name: MANAGE_CHANNELS
perms.label: Manage Channels
perms.note: Allows members to create, edit, or delete channels.

perms.name: MANAGE_ROLES
perms.label: Manage Roles
perms.note: Allows members to create new roles and edit or delete roles lower than their highest role.

perms.name: CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS
perms.label: Create Expressions
perms.note: Allows members to add custom emoji, stickers, and sounds, and edit or remove the ones they added.

perms.name: MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS
perms.label: Manage Expressions
perms.note: Allows members to edit or remove custom emoji, stickers, and sounds.

perms.name: VIEW_AUDIT_LOG
perms.label: View Audit Log
perms.note: Allows members to view a record of who made which changes in this server.

perms.name: MANAGE_WEBHOOKS
perms.label: Manage Webhooks
perms.note: Allows members to create, edit, or delete webhooks, which can post messages from other apps or sites.

perms.name: MANAGE_GUILD
perms.label: Manage Server
perms.note: Allows members to change this server's name, icon and settings, AutoMod rules, and to see and remove invites.

perms.name: CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE
perms.label: Create Invite
perms.note: Allows members to invite new people to this server.

perms.name: CHANGE_NICKNAME
perms.label: Change Nickname
perms.note: Allows members to change their own nickname.

perms.name: MANAGE_NICKNAMES
perms.label: Manage Nicknames
perms.note: Allows members to change the nicknames of other members.

perms.name: KICK_MEMBERS
perms.label: Kick Members
perms.note: Allows members to remove other members from this server.

perms.name: BAN_MEMBERS
perms.label: Ban Members
perms.note: Allows members to permanently ban other members from this server.

perms.name: MODERATE_MEMBERS
perms.label: Timeout Members
perms.note: Allows members to time out other members: they cannot send or react to messages, or speak in voice, for a while.

perms.name: SEND_MESSAGES
perms.label: Send Messages and Create Posts
perms.note: Allows members to send messages in text channels and create posts in forum channels.

perms.name: SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS
perms.label: Send Messages in Threads and Posts
perms.note: Allows members to send messages in threads and forum posts.

perms.name: CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS
perms.label: Create Public Threads
perms.note: Allows members to create threads that everyone in a channel can view.

perms.name: CREATE_PRIVATE_THREADS
perms.label: Create Private Threads
perms.note: Allows members to create invite-only threads.

perms.name: EMBED_LINKS
perms.label: Embed Links
perms.note: Allows links that members share to show embedded content.

perms.name: ATTACH_FILES
perms.label: Attach Files
perms.note: Allows members to upload files or media.

perms.name: ADD_REACTIONS
perms.label: Add Reactions
perms.note: Allows members to add new emoji reactions to a message.

perms.name: USE_EXTERNAL_EMOJIS
perms.label: Use External Emoji
perms.note: Allows members to use emoji from other servers.

perms.name: USE_EXTERNAL_STICKERS
perms.label: Use External Stickers
perms.note: Allows members to use stickers from other servers.

perms.name: MENTION_EVERYONE
perms.label: Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles
perms.note: Allows members to notify everyone and to mention roles that are not mentionable.

perms.name: MANAGE_MESSAGES
perms.label: Manage Messages
perms.note: Allows members to delete and pin messages by other members, remove embeds, and skip slowmode.

perms.name: MANAGE_THREADS
perms.label: Manage Threads and Posts
perms.note: Allows members to rename, delete, archive, lock and pin threads and posts, and to view all private threads.

perms.name: READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY
perms.label: Read Message History
perms.note: Allows members to read previous messages sent in channels.

perms.name: SEND_VOICE_MESSAGES
perms.label: Send Voice Messages
perms.note: Allows members to send voice messages.

perms.name: SEND_POLLS
perms.label: Create Polls
perms.note: Allows members to create polls.

perms.name: USE_APPLICATION_COMMANDS
perms.label: Use Application Commands
perms.note: Allows members to use commands from applications.

perms.name: CONNECT
perms.label: Connect
perms.note: Allows members to join voice channels and hear others.

perms.name: SPEAK
perms.label: Speak
perms.note: Allows members to talk in voice channels.

perms.name: STREAM
perms.label: Video
perms.note: Allows members to share their camera and screen.

perms.name: USE_SOUNDBOARD
perms.label: Use Soundboard
perms.note: Allows members to play sounds from the server soundboard.

perms.name: USE_EXTERNAL_SOUNDS
perms.label: Use External Sounds
perms.note: Allows members to use sounds from other servers.

perms.name: PRIORITY_SPEAKER
perms.label: Priority Speaker
perms.note: Allows members to be more easily heard in voice channels.

perms.name: REQUEST_TO_SPEAK
perms.label: Request to Speak
perms.note: Allows members to request to speak in stage channels.

perms.name: MUTE_MEMBERS
perms.label: Mute Members
perms.note: Allows members to mute other members in voice channels for everyone, and to moderate stages.

perms.name: DEAFEN_MEMBERS
perms.label: Deafen Members
perms.note: Allows members to deafen other members in voice channels.

perms.name: MOVE_MEMBERS
perms.label: Move Members
perms.note: Allows members to disconnect or move other members between voice channels.

perms.name: CREATE_EVENTS
perms.label: Create Events
perms.note: Allows members to create events, and edit and cancel the ones they created.

perms.name: MANAGE_EVENTS
perms.label: Manage Events
perms.note: Allows members to edit and cancel all events.

perms.name: ADMINISTRATOR
perms.label: Administrator
perms.note: Members with this permission have every permission and bypass channel-specific permissions. This is a dangerous permission to grant.
